inlines.v: PREMEDITA'TION, noun [Latin proemeditatio.] 1. The act of meditating beforehand; previous deliberation. A sudden thought may be higher than nature can raise without premeditation 2. Previous contrivance or design formed; as the premeditation of a crime.
